Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic immunopeptidomics workflow focusing on HLA-bound peptides. Label-free quantification (LFQ) is inferred from the lack of labeling reagents and the use of 'Peptide counting' as the quantification method.

scope: For immunoaffinity purification of HLA bound peptides from we applied a previously published protocol (22).

anti-HLA-I and anti-HLA-II monoclonal antibodies were purified from the supernatant of HB95 (ATCC® HB-95™) and HB145 cells (ATCC® HB-145™) and cross linked to protein-A sepharose 4B beads (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, California).
The lysates were passed through a plate containing beads cross-linked to anti-HLA-I and then sequentially through a plate with the anti-HLA-II cross-linked beads.
HLA complexes and the bound peptides were eluted directly into two pre-conditioned Sep-Pak tC18 100 mg plates (Waters) with 1% TFA.
